display_name: Schema.org v30.1 Reference & XSS-Safe JSON-LD Vault

entries.title: schema.org/Book & BookSeries Required Properties
entries.summary: Emit clean schema.org/Book and BookSeries JSON-LD using plain https://schema.org/ enum URLs and exact ADR-025c Offer.price strings.
rules: Set @context to plain 'https://schema.org' and bookFormat to plain 'https://schema.org/Paperback', 'https://schema.org/EBook', 'https://schema.org/Hardcover', or 'https://schema.org/AudiobookFormat'.
Include name, author (@type Person), isbn, numberOfPages (exact base-10 integer string), inLanguage, genre, typicalAgeRange, and offers (@type Offer with exact price string and priceCurrency).
Never wrap schema.org URLs in Markdown link brackets inside JSON-LD fields.

entries.title: XSS-Safe Script Tag Escaping for JSON-LD
entries.summary: Neutralize script breakout vectors in every emitted JSON-LD preview before embedding inside HTML script tags.
rules: Escape '<' as \u003c, '>' as \u003e, '&' as \u0026, U+2028 as \u2028, and U+2029 as \u2029 in serialized JSON-LD.
Verify closing script tags never appear unescaped anywhere inside json_ld_escaped.
Validate all user-supplied book titles and blurbs against XSS_PATTERN before staging.

entries.title: Product, Article, BlogPosting, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList & WebSite Patterns
entries.summary: Match visible page entities strictly to supported schema.org v30.1 types with verifiable URLs and exact decimal offer strings.
rules: Use Product with Offer (@type Offer, price as exact base-10 string, https://schema.org/InStock) for direct-to-reader book bundles.
Use FAQPage only when every Question and acceptedAnswer matches visible page copy word-for-word.
Include BreadcrumbList and WebSite SearchAction metadata for clean site hierarchy signals.
